title: EmbeddingResult
description: The result of `embed_full`, `section_embed` or `stem_embed`: pooled CLAP-family vectors (specs/04-analysis-pipeline.md §6.1). The exact windowing and vector layout are an open question for the embedding work package.

dim.description: Vector length; 512 for the v1 CLAP checkpoints (04 §6.1).

lowConfidence.description: True when the audio had too little energy or duration to embed meaningfully; the vectors are still published (04 §10).

scopeRef.description: Section id (for `scope: "section"`) or stem role (for `scope: "stem"`); absent for a song-level vector.
